step_risks_and_controls.risk: Replenishment of low-margin items prioritized over high-impact items.
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated prioritization based on margin and velocity.

subprocess_flow.scope: Automated data processing within the ERP environment.
governance_requirements: Compliance with ERP data integrity standards.

change_management.change_request_process: Logic updates via Supply Chain Steering Committee.

end_conditions: Draft orders are visible in the ERP system.
subprocess_flow.description: The ERP system processes the verified stock-out report and sales velocity data to calculate replenishment priority. It automatically generates draft emergency purchase orders or stock transfer requests based on pre-defined margin and velocity logic, ensuring high-impact items are addressed first.
success_criteria: Draft orders generated within 30 minutes of stock-out verification.
subprocess_flow.purpose: To rapidly identify and prepare the most critical items for replenishment.

subprocess_flow.scope: Review of automated drafts for accuracy and feasibility.
success_criteria: 100% of draft orders reviewed for accuracy.
subprocess_flow.description: The Inventory Control Manager reviews the draft orders to ensure the prioritization aligns with current business needs and that the chosen fulfillment method (PO vs. STR) is feasible. This step provides a human check on the automated logic to account for external factors not captured by the ERP.

step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory review by Inventory Control Manager.

subprocess_flow.triggers: Completion of draft generation in ERP.
subprocess_flow.purpose: To ensure human oversight on automated replenishment decisions.
governance_requirements: Audit trail of all draft order modifications.
end_conditions: Replenishment plan is validated and ready for financial audit.

subprocess_flow.triggers: Validated replenishment plan ready for release.

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Expedited shipping costs exceeding the 10% retail value budget constraint.
step_risks_and_controls.control: ERP-integrated budget tracking and mandatory secondary approval for >10% costs.

success_criteria: All shipping expenses validated against the 10% threshold.
end_conditions: Shipping costs are approved or adjusted to fit budget.
governance_requirements: Adherence to expedited shipping budget constraints.
subprocess_flow.purpose: To maintain financial discipline during emergency replenishment.
subprocess_flow.scope: Financial compliance and budget auditing for shipping.
subprocess_flow.description: Evaluate the estimated expedited shipping costs against the 10% retail value budget constraint. If the cost exceeds the threshold, the Warehouse Manager must trigger a mandatory secondary approval from the Finance Department to justify the expense.

end_conditions: Orders are successfully transmitted to external or internal partners.
subprocess_flow.description: The Warehouse Manager officially releases the approved purchase orders or stock transfer requests to the suppliers or internal warehouse locations. Transmission is handled via EDI or the ERP portal to ensure immediate notification and minimize transit delays.

step_risks_and_controls.control: ERP transmission logs and automated failure alerts.
step_risks_and_controls.risk: Order transmission failure resulting in replenishment delays.

subprocess_flow.purpose: To initiate the physical movement of goods from the source to the stock-out location.
success_criteria: Orders transmitted within 4 hours of the initial trigger.
Order acknowledgment received for all emergency requests.
subprocess_flow.purpose: To confirm the supply chain response has been initiated and accepted.
end_conditions: Replenishment order is acknowledged by supplier/warehouse.
subprocess_flow.scope: Supplier relationship management and order tracking.
governance_requirements: Documentation of supplier commitment to delivery timelines.

step_risks_and_controls.control: Follow-up protocol if no response within 2 hours of transmission.
step_risks_and_controls.risk: Supplier fails to acknowledge order in a timely manner.

subprocess_flow.description: Monitor the communication channels for acknowledgment from the supplier or the fulfilling warehouse. This step ensures that the replenishment request has been received and scheduled for expedited processing, closing the loop on the triggering phase.
